summary: Fix confirmed. With tkinter made unimportable, `import exllamav3` raised ImportError at the affected commit b124ceb2d598 and the fix parent 04dc55717c49, through exllamav3/__init__.py:5 -> generator/__init__.py:1 -> generator/generator.py:13 -> generator/visualizer.py:2 (the module-scope tkinter import), without any visualization being requested. At the fix 8d07bfb892c1 exllamav3 imported and Generator was available.
what_ran: repro.py puts a shim tkinter.py that raises ImportError first on sys.path, confirms tkinter is unimportable, then imports exllamav3 and Generator from the worktree. Environment py311-81fd62ef04f7-torch26cu126. No GPU needed.
limits: tkinter absence is modelled with a shim module rather than a Python build without Tk; a real build without _tkinter may fail with a different ImportError message at the same import. Import only; the visualizer itself was not exercised.
modifications: Environment only: no_tkinter/tkinter.py, first on sys.path, raises ImportError on import to model a Python without Tk. No upstream file is modified or stubbed.
